aggregator.explanation: All six dimension agents favor Lesson 1, most with very high confidence. Lesson 1 is judged superior in visual accuracy, interactivity, narration, sync, concept accuracy, and polish. The strongest factors are that Lesson 1 correctly presents the inclusion-exclusion reasoning, includes functional quiz interactivity, has clear narration, and provides aligned visual support, while Lesson 2 is missing transcript/timing/interactivity evidence and has weaker visual and layout execution. With unanimous dimension votes and high confidence overall, Lesson 1 is the clear winner.
